algorithm: ml-dsa PKCS#8 private keys, all three parameter sets
source: OpenSSL 3.5.7 9 Jun 2026 (Library: OpenSSL 3.5.7 9 Jun 2026), generated by scripts/gen_mldsa_pkcs8.py: per set and seed, openssl genpkey -algorithm <set> -pkeyopt hexseed:<seed>; openssl pkey -text -noout for the expanded key; openssl pkey -outform DER -provparam ml-dsa.output_formats=seed-only|priv-only|seed-priv for the three RFC 9881 forms. An independent implementation, not a NIST vector.
